dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible cluster of 5-6 high-contrast light-toned rings ('O' shapes) on the posterior-lateral flank. Perimeters are thin with a sharp gradient transition from the dark base pelage to a light-intensity boundary, enclosing dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse distribution of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters located primarily along the dorsal ridge and at the posterior margins of the visible pattern field.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-posterior flank form an approximate isosceles triangle, with the apex oriented toward the ventral-posterior edge.
